title: CanonKit project configuration
description: Optional editor assistance for .claude/canonkit.json. Runtime validation remains authoritative: doctor warns about ignored entries, and the hook rejects catch-all excludes (including combinations) that this schema cannot detect.

version.description: Configuration version. Optional; only version 1 is supported. Other versions cause the hook to use defaults.

highRisk.description: Additional protected paths and narrow exclusions from ambiguous path heuristics. Includes take precedence over excludes.

include.description: Add confirmation gates, including for lint/test configuration, tests and fixtures. Does not change domain ownership or review rules.

exclude.description: Silence ambiguous path heuristics only. Cannot exclude includes, auth, secrets, migrations or the gate configuration itself. Catch-all exclusions, individually or combined, are rejected at runtime.

perfBudgets.description: Additional performance budget files. Built-in budgets remain protected; only Perry may loosen a threshold.

globList.description: Case-insensitive, project-relative globs. A slash anchors the path; otherwise match the filename at any depth. * and ? stay in a segment; ** as a whole segment crosses folders. Trailing / means everything below. ! and brackets are literal. The hook reads at most 100 entries per list and files up to 64 KiB.
